headline: Reserve request for water system design on LaFountain St. and Park St., and a closed-door legal discussion on the former Armory lot.
summary: A reserve request for water system design work is on the agenda, along with a proposed executive session on contracts with CHT and the National Guard for the former Armory lot.
items: Reserve request for design engineering for water system on LaFountain St. and Park St.
Proposed executive session on contracts with CHT and the National Guard for the former Armory lot
Reserve request for design engineering for water system on LaFountain St. and Park St. (listed again at the end of the agenda)

Special Winooski City Council Meeting
l Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6 PM 
l Attend at City Hall: 27 W Allen Street
l Attend online: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84364849328
l Attend by phone: 1 646 558 8656 
l Webinar ID: 843 6484 9328
Call to Order
Pledge of Allegiance
Agenda Review
Public Comment
The City of Winooski encourages public comment during City Council 
meetings. Please:
l Sit at the public comment table and speak into the microphone - do not 
comment from the audience 
l State your name and address where you live 
l Direct your comment to the City Council - staff may follow up after the 
meeting if appropriate 
l Keep your comment to 2 minutes if possible 
l If attending online: test your camera and mic before joining, use your real 
first and last name, use the raise hand function during public comment
Consent Agenda
Approval: City Council Meeting Minutes of November 2, 2026
11.02.26 CC Minutes.pdf
Regular Items
Discussion/Approval: Reserve Request: Design Engineering for Water 
System on LaFountain St. and Park St. - Elaine Wang, City Manager, 
Jon Rauscher, Public Works Director, and Ryan Lambert, City 
Engineer
Coversheet.pdf
Proposed Executive Session
Discussion: Pursuant to 1 V.S.A. §313 (a)(1)(F), confidential attorney-
client communications made for the purpose of providing professional 
legal services to the body regarding contracts with CHT and the 
National Guard as to the former Armory lot - Elaine Wang, City 
Manager, and Kathy Zhou, Paul Frank and Collins, P.C.
